solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Referee's parting shots for sub, for example

indicators.note: parting means the shots word is split apart to take the official inside

parts.note: pix is informal for pictures, photographic shots
ref is the short form of referee

explanation.surface: A referee's farewell remarks to a substitute, as if he had a last word on the way out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parting shots' reads as last remarks, but parting is the container signal. 'sub' looks like a substitute but is the word-start sub-.
explanation.definitionFit: Sub-, as in submarine, is an element fixed to the front of a word, the grammatical category named here.

clue.text: Briefly visit Japan? Yes, that'll be dandy

parts.note: to pop in is to drop by for a short call
J is the international vehicle registration code for Japan
aye is an old or dialect word for yes

explanation.surface: A quick trip to Japan pitched as just the thing for a smart dresser.
explanation.definitionFit: A dandy is a vain, showily dressed man; the old word for such a fop also names a parrot.

clue.text: Leaves in good time, catching up some work

indicators.note: catching means the outer word holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: early means ahead of schedule, in good time

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word erg is read from bottom to top

parts.note: an erg is a unit of work in physics

explanation.surface: Someone departs promptly, managing to fit in a bit of work on the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb but is the definition: tea leaves. ERG is a physics unit of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea is sold as dried leaves, and this blend flavoured with bergamot is a well-known variety.

clue.text: Encourage awareness when holding forth

indicators.note: holding forth means speaking at length, so the word is judged by how it is said aloud

parts.note: insight is a deep awareness or understanding

explanation.surface: Speaking out at length is said to stimulate understanding in an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: To encourage someone, especially to act, is to urge or stir them on, a close synonym.

clue.text: For a start, swimming pool's not so very clean

indicators.note: for a start points to the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: a pool of money, as in a kitty, is a pot
less means not so much, to a smaller degree

explanation.surface: A swimming pool described as not entirely clean, opening a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without a single mark or stain is perfectly clean, an exact synonym.

clue.text: Dance is cut short for former president

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter is lopped off the word

parts.note: the polka is a lively Bohemian couple dance

explanation.surface: A dance performance curtailed, perhaps for lack of time.
explanation.walkthrough: James K. Polk was the eleventh President of the United States (1845-49).
explanation.definitionFit: James Polk led the USA in the 1840s, so he is a past head of state.

clue.text: Craft dress with a certain knitwear style

parts.note: to dress something, as a shop window or a garment, is to trim it
Aran is a style of chunky cable-knit sweater from the Aran Islands

explanation.surface: Instructions to decorate a garment in a particular style of knitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat is a craft, and this one is a sailing vessel with three parallel hulls.

clue.text: Have meal in café? It may offer tea!

parts.note: read the answer's first word as letters and its second as an anagram signal: those letters mixed up give the word tea

explanation.surface: Dining in a café, which may well serve tea.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: taken as wordplay, the answer would be read as the three letters followed by 'out', meaning rearranged, which yields TEA.
explanation.definitionFit: Dining at a restaurant or café rather than at home is the everyday sense of this phrasal verb.

clue.text: Son has more fancy new address

indicators.note: fancy here means elaborately reworked, so the letters of more are rearranged

explanation.surface: A boy now has a smarter, newer place to live.
explanation.walkthrough: 'address' seems to be where the son lives, but it means a speech.
explanation.definitionFit: An address can be a formal speech, and a preacher's talk from the pulpit is one.

clue.text: Vehicle's turned in one year after parking offence

indicators.note: after means the rest of the wordplay follows the parking letter
in means one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: turned means the word car is read backwards

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A car turned around within a year of a parking violation, like a motoring court report.
explanation.definitionFit: Copying or distributing material illegally, or robbery at sea, is a criminal act.

clue.text: Son cuts college to hang around arcade

indicators.note: cuts means the letter slices into the other word

parts.note: to loiter is to hang around aimlessly

explanation.surface: A student skips lectures to idle about in a shopping arcade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arcade' suggests shops or games, but here it is a covered colonnade.
explanation.definitionFit: An arcade is a covered walk lined with arches, which is what the walkway round a monastery courtyard is.

clue.text: They run football match catastrophically

parts.note: the FA, the Football Association, governs the game in England
to tally is to match or correspond

explanation.surface: The football authorities are blamed for a disastrous game.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done disastrously, with deadly results, is done in a way that causes death or ruin.

clue.text: Drink knocked back, around time chap crashes?

definitions.text: Drink knocked back, around time chap crashes?

indicators.note: knocked back means the word gin is read in reverse

parts.note: gin is a drink

indicators.note: around means the scrambled letters go round the time letter
crashes means the letters of chap are wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: A drink downed at about the hour a man flops into bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: 'crashes' doubles as going to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: A last alcoholic drink taken before bed is exactly what the whole clue describes.

clue.text: Without limits, José Cura could be a legendary tenor

indicators.note: could be means the letters can be rearranged into something else
without limits means the first and last letters of José are dropped

explanation.surface: José Cura, a modern tenor, could become as great as the legends if freed of constraints.
explanation.walkthrough: José Cura is a real Argentine tenor; Enrico Caruso was the famous Italian tenor of the early twentieth century.
explanation.definitionFit: Enrico Caruso is one of the most celebrated operatic tenors of all time.

clue.text: Argument about way journalist's spun yarn

indicators.note: about means the word row is turned round

parts.note: a row is a quarrel
St is the abbreviation for street, a way
ed, short for editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A quarrel over a reporter who invented a tall story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spun yarn' looks like a made-up tale but is literal wool thread.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a smooth woollen thread made from combed long-staple wool, literally a spun yarn.

clue.text: State eclipsed by Montana and Vermont combined

indicators.note: eclipsed by means most of the name is blotted out, leaving only its closing letter
combined says the second name joins straight on, its tail swallowed into the join so only its opening three letters show

explanation.surface: A US state overshadowed by Montana and Vermont put together.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter meant the answer as hidden across the two names run together, ignoring 'and': the last letter of Montana plus the first three of Vermont. 'State' looks like a US state but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To aver is to declare or assert something positively, a formal synonym of the verb.

clue.text: Springtime examination of public dignitary?

parts.note: May is a month of spring
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A spring test of some civic official, posed as a question.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things belonging to a town's chief civic official, such as a chain of office.

clue.text: Muscles in on half of Blithe Spirit

parts.note: abs are abdominal muscles

indicators.note: half of means the second three of the six letters of Blithe

explanation.surface: Someone muscling in on a share of Noël Coward's play Blithe Spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: Blithe Spirit is a Noël Coward comedy; 'Spirit' looks like part of the title but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirit means a strong distilled drink, and this green, anise-flavoured liquor is one.

clue.text: Country club entertainer meets singles keeping fit

indicators.note: meets means the pieces simply join side by side

parts.note: a DJ plays records in a nightclub

indicators.note: keeping means the two letters hold the other piece between them

parts.note: singles are ones, so two I's, the Roman numeral one
a bout is a fit or attack, as of coughing

explanation.surface: A club DJ joins single people who are staying in shape.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a small nation in the Horn of Africa, on the Gulf of Aden.

clue.text: Our unit oddly has reputation for interior decoration

indicators.note: for interior means the reputation word is placed inside the other letters
oddly means take the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of the words Our unit

parts.note: a name is a reputation, as in making a name for yourself

explanation.surface: A team is known for its interior design work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interior decoration' reads as one phrase, but 'interior' belongs to the wordplay and only 'decoration' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: An ornament is an object used to adorn a room, so it is a decoration.

clue.text: Blokeish freak, needing shot of heroin, produces needle

indicators.note: freak means the letters are wildly rearranged
needing shot of means getting rid of the heroin letter

parts.note: H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: A laddish addict needs a fix of heroin and produces a syringe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needle' and 'shot' suggest drug use, but needle here is a tall stone pillar like Cleopatra's Needle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapering stone pillar, such as Cleopatra's Needle in London, is often called a needle.

clue.text: Indian prince is making comeback, or just about to

indicators.note: making a comeback means the word comes back, read in reverse

parts.note: a raja is an Indian prince or king

explanation.surface: An Indian prince is staging a return, or is on the point of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' here means shut, as in pushing a door to; 'about to' looks like 'on the point of'.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left slightly open is nearly shut, and to as an adverb means closed.

clue.text: Opening for film score in motion picture

indicators.note: opening for means take the first letter of film
in motion means the letters of score move around

explanation.surface: A film's opening music plays during a movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'motion picture' reads as one phrase; 'motion' is the anagram signal and 'picture' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a painting made on wet plaster on a wall, a kind of picture.

clue.text: Avoid key issue

definitions.meaning: to avoid is to evade or get away from
the Esc key on a computer keyboard is named this
an issue can be a leak or outflow, as of gas

explanation.surface: Steering clear of the central problem.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to evade, names a keyboard key, and as a noun means a leak, matching all three.

clue.text: Plane perhaps possessed by special actress

indicators.note: possessed by means the tree goes inside the other letters

parts.note: the plane is a tree, so a tree is an example

explanation.surface: An aircraft owned by a special performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plane' suggests an aircraft but is the plane tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Meryl Streep is a celebrated American film actress.

clue.text: Are you on the phone, getting endless flak? That's awkward

parts.note: in phone text-speak the two words are written as the letters R and U, which sound the same

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is removed

parts.note: stick is slang for harsh criticism or flak

explanation.surface: Someone takes a call and gets abuse down the line, which is uncomfortable.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustic can mean rough and unsophisticated, clumsy in manner, as in a rough country bumpkin.

clue.text: Outside bet backing King's Lynn? That shows some backbone

indicators.note: outside means the singer's name goes round the other letters

parts.note: Vera Lynn was the British wartime singer, the Forces' Sweetheart

indicators.note: backing means the word bet is read in reverse

parts.note: R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A long-odds wager on King's Lynn, a Norfolk town, shows courage.
explanation.walkthrough: King's Lynn is a town in Norfolk; split, Lynn is Vera Lynn and King gives R.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the bones of the spinal column, so a piece of the backbone.

clue.text: Flutter nets a pound

indicators.note: nets means catches, holding the letter inside

parts.note: a flutter is a small bet

explanation.surface: A small wager wins a pound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pound' looks like money but is a verb, to hit.
explanation.definitionFit: To pound and this verb both mean to strike repeatedly, as of a drum or a heart.

clue.text: TV show to turn on right geek regularly

parts.note: to start an engine or device is to turn it on

indicators.note: regularly means take every other letter of geek

explanation.surface: A TV programme likely to appeal to a nerd.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-running science-fiction television series about the starship Enterprise, with a famous geeky following.

clue.text: Fellow stops recycling rubbish

indicators.note: stops means the letter plugs a gap inside the other word

parts.note: recycling something means you reuse it

explanation.surface: A man halts his recycling of waste.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbish and this noun both mean waste matter that is thrown away.

clue.text: Before European character runs off, order dish

indicators.note: before means the order letters come first

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit

indicators.note: off means the runs letter is removed

parts.note: a letter is a character of the alphabet
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A diner orders a dish before a European character makes off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' sounds like ordering food but gives OM, Britain's Order of Merit.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a dish of beaten eggs fried in a pan, often folded around a filling.

clue.text: Make an impression, following second career

indicators.note: following means the print piece comes after the second letter

parts.note: to print is to make an impression, as of type on paper

explanation.surface: Someone makes their mark in a second career.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a job but is a verb, to rush along.
explanation.definitionFit: To career is to rush headlong at speed, which is to run flat out.
